sections.seoTitle: Kids & Adults Creative Workshops at Home | Poppy in the Sky
sections.seoDescription: Discover Valérie's world and her mobile creative workshops at home. Customized arts, crafts, and cooking activities for children and adults in Hérault and Gard.
sections.courseDescription: Mobile arts, crafts, and creative leisure workshops at home for individuals, birthdays, bachelorette parties (EVJF), and professional organizations.

informations.title: Welcome to POPPY IN THE SKY !

videos.title: Présentation de Poppy In The Sky

description: My name is Valérie, and for 20 years, I have been organising and running creative leisure workshops for children, teenagers, and adults.

Whether at your home, in a company, school, or association, I travel with all the necessary material to offer you an original, festive, and friendly creative break! You choose the activity, and I take care of the rest.

informations.title: How to book your workshop?
description: Each session lasts approximately 2 hours (indoors, or in the garden during summer) with a table and a chair for each participant.
Participants: Minimum of 5 for children, 4 for adults (maximum 10 people). From 5 years old and up.
Availability: From Monday to Sunday, all year round.
Travel Fees: Flat rate of €15 from Monday to Saturday / €20 on Sundays and public holidays (beyond 30km, upon request).
Booking: A 30% deposit is required (via bank transfer or Paypal).
Important: A guaranteed parking space nearby is necessary to unload the equipment.

informations.title: Travel Zones
description: I mainly travel within Montpellier and its metropolitan area (Castelnau, Fabrègues, Lattes, St-Jean-de-Védas, Lunel, Mauguio, etc.).
I also offer workshops on specific dates around Le Cailar (30) and Castres (81).
Your town is not on the list? Contact me to get a customized quote!

informations.title: Why take a creative break?
description: Creating while having fun is excellent for morale and helps soothe daily stress. It is also a wonderful tool for personal development:
Identity & Expression: Allows you to express emotions, ideas, and assert your originality.
Self-esteem: Empowers both children and adults through the pride of making an object with their own hands.
Focus & Mindfulness: Develops concentration, patience, and offers a true moment of disconnection.

sections.seoTitle: Nature & Wooden Crafts Workshops for Kids (34/30)
sections.seoDescription: Creative workshops for kids at home: customize large wooden hearts or create seasonal botanical frames in Hérault and Gard.
sections.courseDescription: Workshops focusing on clay molding, painting, and botanical art to develop fine motor skills, creativity, and the exploration of natural textures.

informations.title: The Large Wooden Heart
description: A beautiful 29 cm wall decoration made of lightweight wood, ready to be fully customized.
Children will learn sponge gradient painting, how to use molding paste, and how to cast air-dry clay ornaments.
Each child selects their own colors and embellishments for a truly unique piece.
I provide all necessary supplies: the wooden base, paints, modeling pastes, molds, and decorative details (rhinestones, flowers).
<tr>Price: €25 / child (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

informations.title: Seasonal Botanical Frame
description: Recommended for ages 6 and up (possible from age 5 for children used to crafting).
On a 12 cm wooden frame, each child creates their own mini-garden using seasonal items: moss, wood, flowers, handmade ceramics, or miniature mushrooms and pumpkins.
A playful and ideal workshop to connect children with nature while having fun.
<tr>Price: €20 / child (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

sections.seoTitle: Jewelry & Accessories Making Workshop for Kids at Home
sections.seoDescription: Fun DIY jewelry workshops at home: UV resin keychains, charm bars, and custom bag charms for a perfect birthday party.
sections.courseDescription: An introduction to fashion jewelry making and precision assembly: handling specialized pliers, UV resin work, color harmony, and creating unique accessories.

informations.title: UV Resin Initial Keychain
description: Recommended for ages 7 and up. Duration: approx. 1.5 hours.
Using a silicone mold of their initial, children discover the magic of UV resin to embed glitter, colors, and decorations of their choice.
The initial is then mounted on a chain with a clasp, ribbon, and tassel. Perfect for learning basic jewelry-making techniques!
<tr>Price: €18 / child (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

informations.title: The Charm Bar
description: Recommended for ages 9 and up (requires good dexterity).
Children choose from a wide variety of high-quality themed charms to design either a matching bracelet and earrings set, or a necklace and earrings set.
Adaptable all year round according to your preferred theme (Christmas, summer, celebration...).
<tr>Price: €13 / child (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

informations.title: Bag Charms & Tassel Keychains
description: Recommended for ages 6 and up.
Create a trendy accessory to decorate a schoolbag or a key ring using a wide variety of professional supplies.
I provide: steel and cotton threads, diverse beads, ribbons, handmade ceramic charms, tassels, and carabiners.
A guaranteed professional result with endless combinations.
<tr>Price: €14 / child (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

sections.seoTitle: Creative Stationery & Notebook Workshops for Kids (34/30)
sections.seoDescription: Scrapbooking and custom diary or art journal workshops at home. An engaging manual activity for kids' birthday parties.
sections.courseDescription: Paper craft and self-expression workshop using mixed media techniques (collage, painting, stamping) to customize diaries or memory books.

informations.title: Art Journal & Memory Book
description: Recommended for ages 5 and up. Duration: approx. 2 hours.
Focuses on the complete customization of the front cover. Children explore collage and painting to bring their notebook to life based on their favorite theme.
Perfect as a photo album, travel journal, herbarium, poetry book, or sports score tracker.
I provide: the high-quality journal, paints, glue, and beautiful decorative embellishments (vintage papers, tassels, rhinestones).
<tr>Price: €24 / child (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

informations.title: Decorated Secret Diary
description: Recommended for ages 4 and up.
Ornameting a Bristol-type notebook (20 cm high) that will hold children's secrets, drawings, or thoughts.
Using unique textures: fabrics, handmade ceramic mosaics, wood, glass elements, and dimensional relief paints for the final touch.
Each creation is personalized to match the child's style (pen not included).
<tr>Price: €12 / child (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

sections.seoTitle: Painting & Watercolor Introduction Workshops - Hérault & Gard
sections.seoDescription: Discover our painting workshops in Hérault and Gard. From traditional watercolor introduction to 3D textured painting and outdoor decor upcycling.
sections.courseDescription: Comprehensive art workshops centered on pigment blending, color harmonies, and textures, combining fluid traditional media with modern heavy body styles.

informations.title: Introduction to Watercolor
description: Technical class focused on blending pigments on dampened pure cotton paper, ideal for landscapes and botanical patterns.
Learn to master blending by exploring the traditional 'wet-on-wet' (or wet-in-wet) technique.
Two guided study themes are available: botanical patterns (cotton flowers) or landscape composition.
All premium supplies are included: high-quality pure cotton watercolor paper and varied pigment palettes.
Workshop open to adults and accessible to teenagers from 10 years old, perfect for intergenerational sessions.
<tr>Price: €20 / person (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people.</tr>

informations.title: Textured Painting: Modeling Paste
description: Explore texture-building on a 12x12 cm square canvas to add a three-dimensional dimension to your artwork.
Techniques covered: application of structure paste (modeling paste), handling palette knives, using artistic stencils, and acrylic layering.
Two floral designs guide the learning process (poppy or magnolia), while allowing everyone to express their own graphic style.
Average duration: 3 hours. All necessary supplies are fully provided.
<tr>Price: €40 / person.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people.</tr>

informations.title: Painted Flower Pot
description: Elevate a traditional terracotta pot (approx. 15 cm high) using professional illustration techniques for porous objects.
A step-by-step method makes it easy to paint precise patterns (graphic, bohemian, or botanical) with an impeccable finish.
The clay pot, specific acrylic paints, and outdoor protective varnishes (ensuring high durability) are fully provided.
Duration: approx. 3 hours.
<tr>Price: €30 / person.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people.</tr>

informations.title: Hand-Painted Roof Tile
description: A traditional Provençal craft experience to reinvent authentic antique terracotta tiles into unique wall art or elegant house numbers.
The learning process is simplified with easy pattern transfer methods and vertical composition tips to ensure a flawless result.
I provide one large authentic terracotta tile per participant as well as all suitable outdoor painting supplies.
Average duration: 3 hours.
<tr>Price: €50 / person.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people.</tr>

sections.seoTitle: Art Journaling & Handmade Decor Workshops - Unique Crafts
sections.seoDescription: Express your inner self: cozy mixed-media Art Journal workshops and upcycling genuine scallop shells into golden jewelry dishes.
sections.courseDescription: Craft and self-expression workshops centered around custom books and souvenir objects, using collage, visual journaling, gilding, and clear glossy finishes.

informations.title: Art Journal: Memory or Travel Book
description: Fine arts and light art-therapy journal workshop, blending free illustration techniques and creative relaxation.
Workshop duration: approx. 2 hours focused on creating the front cover.
A mixed-media workshop centered on relaxation, blending artistic collage and painting techniques to customize a high-quality journal (20 x 20 cm).
Each participant selects their own theme depending on the book's purpose: travel log, photo memory book, herbarium, recipe book, or personal diary.
Professional-grade supplies included: hardcover journal, themed papers, textures, paints, stencils, and refined details (rhinestones, ribbons, lace).
<tr>Price: €30 / person (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people.</tr>

informations.title: Scallop Shell Trinket Dish
description: Transform an authentic, large scallop shell (10 to 12 cm) into a refined decorative object or an elegant jewelry bowl.
Complete technical training: applying delicate decorative patterns, gold leaf gilding, and mastering the UV resin glazing process to vitrify and protect the piece.
The workshop price includes the shell, all decorative supplies, and an elegant brass tripod to showcase your finished trinket dish.
<tr>Price: €25 / person.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people.</tr>

sections.seoTitle: Fashion Jewelry Making, UV Resin & Suncatchers Workshops - DIY
sections.seoDescription: Design your custom jewelry sets, learn the craft of UV resin casting, or assemble a crystal suncatcher during our specialized technical workshops.
sections.courseDescription: Technical training focusing on precision assembly, handling specialized findings, and working with fast-curing synthetic resins.

informations.title: Adult Jewelry Workshop
description: Design a custom jewelry set and learn professional fashion jewelry assembly techniques (using specific pliers, choosing findings, securing clasps, and eye-pin looping).
Each participant leaves with a full matching set of choice: necklace/ring, necklace/earrings, bracelet/ring, or bracelet/earrings.
An exceptional supply bar is provided: thousands of selected beads, tassels, chains, and bases in various styles.
Average duration: 2.5 hours.
<tr>Price: €40 / person.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people, maximum 10 people.</tr>

informations.title: UV Resin Workshop
description: Learn to handle fast-curing synthetic resin to design either a refined pair of earrings or a complete necklace (pendant and chain).
Technical training on pouring and meticulously embedding delicate elements: natural dried flowers, gold/silver leaves, and glass micro-beads.
Leave with a unique, durable, and perfectly cured piece of jewelry under UV lamps.
Duration: 1.5 hours. All technical tools and jewelry findings are included.
<tr>Price: €30 / person (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people.</tr>

informations.title: Crystal Suncatcher
description: Hanging glassware design workshop, teaching how to assemble crystal prisms to capture and refract natural light.
Create a customized light-catching object while learning professional jewelry assembly and mounting techniques.
A wide selection of high-quality supplies is provided: gold or silver metal, iridescent glass pieces, chains, and various themed charms (moons, suns, lotus).
This workshop is open to participants aged 10 and up. Ideal for a shared creative moment as a parent/child duo.
<tr>Price: €30 / person (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people.</tr>

sections.seoTitle: Creative Bachelorette Party (EVJF) & Private Events - Hérault & Gard
sections.seoDescription: Celebrate your milestone moments with friends! Organization of festive, customized creative workshops for bachelorette parties, birthdays, and private events.
sections.courseDescription: Event services and private, high-end creative workshop hosting, blending premium DIY craft, relaxation, and shared fun.

informations.title: A Unique, Festive & Creative Gathering!
description: In close partnership with Maguelonne (Maison Magalona), we craft unforgettable festive and artistic brackets to celebrate the bride-to-be or your milestones.

Mix and match your dream schedule by combining our services: premium art crafts and DIY workshops (pottery, designer jewelry bar, denim jacket customization, contemporary mosaic frames, mixed-media journals) paired with spa sessions, relaxing massages, or fine cooking classes.
Every group has its own story: we shape a completely customized program aligned with your desires, timing, and inspirations.
Flexible hosting for absolute peace of mind: we travel directly to your venue (home, cottage, Airbnb), welcome your group at our private workshops, or host you at our partner institute.
Join us to enjoy a suspended moment, laugh, create together, and take home a beautiful handcrafted keepsake.
<tr>Custom packages available on quote, typically ranging from €60 to €150 per person depending on the selected options and workshops.</tr>

sections.seoTitle: Creative & Artistic Workshops for Schools, Youth Centers & Care Homes
sections.seoDescription: Tailored artistic interventions for institutions: schools, leisure centers, and nursing homes in Hérault and Gard. Age-appropriate workshops.
sections.courseDescription: Fine arts and creative stimulation workshop programs adapted for school groups, youth activity centers, and senior residents in nursing homes.

informations.title: Schools, Middle Schools & Youth Activity Centers (ALSH)
description: Enhance your educational projects, extracurricular programs, and holiday camps with ready-to-run artistic interventions tailored to every age group.

I design bespoke workshops that align with your annual themes: pottery and clay sculpting (tableware, family portrait plaques, cave painting styles, garden ornaments), modern arts and crafts (UV resin jewelry, upcycling, journaling), as well as introductions to macramé, botanical art, and vocal expression.

A proven track record with multiple local institutions: regular sessions at the leisure center and schools in Pignan, schools and middle school in Fabrègues (34), school in St Siffret (30), leisure center in Boirargues, Les Aiguerelles in Montpellier, and the MJC in Mauguio.
Flexible and mobile, I travel with all the necessary professional supplies across the Hérault (34), Gard (30), and Tarn (81) departments, matching your scheduling needs.
Contact me at +33 6 60 75 34 38 or via email to co-create your project and receive a personalized quote tailored to your budget.

informations.title: Nursing Homes & Senior Residences (EHPAD)
description: Sensory, cognitive stimulation and self-esteem workshops specifically designed for residents in nursing homes and senior care facilities.

Through gentle and adapted creative activities such as clay modeling, therapeutic painting, or delicate handicrafts, these sessions help maintain fine motor skills, stimulate memory, and foster social connections.
Each session is built around empathy and care, providing a warm, rewarding, and fulfilling creative escape for the participants.
Bespoke interventions available for year-round planning or short-term projects in the 34, 30, and 81 areas. Free quotes provided on request.

informations.title: GIFT VOUCHER to offer
description: Would you like to treat someone and give them a gift voucher?
To do so, simply contact me here and we will define the gift you want together.
This can be a voucher for a creative workshop... a voucher for a cooking workshop... an amount to spend in my shops... or something else if you have another idea.
Birthday gift, Christmas gift, friendship gift, bachelorette party, any amount is possible, and your voucher will be valid for 1 year from the day of purchase.
See you soon.
